vitality_sprites.format: indexed PNG, 128x128, shared <=32 colors including transparent, no dithering, no antialiasing
vitality_sprites.registration: Content is fitted to the same box as the existing timer-state sprites, approx (15,11)-(110,122), so swapping hungry/sick onto (56,43) stays the same size.

compositing.full: When vitality is full, keep the existing FOCUS/BREAK/COMPLETE/STANDBY character sprites. The delivered full sprite is a healthy reference (optional idle), not a replacement for the four timer faces.
compositing.hungry_or_sick: When vitality is hungry or sick, blit the matching vitality sprite at (56, 43) in place of the timer-state character. Stage label, background color, time, Today N/G, streak, and online dot stay as they are.
compositing.hud: Do not add a status bar. Do not change Today N/G or streak positions.
compositing.standby_dim: STANDBY dimming remains backlight, not baked into the sprite.

notes: Three vitality looks only; no medicine, no feed icon, no new HUD.
ASCII HUD and Press Start 2P unchanged.
